'''Cloud flies''' were [[Insect/Legends|insects]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. A display of cloud flies was included in the [[Atrium]] in the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]].<ref name="Game">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref>
